name: Sentry
summary: Report failed Ogun runs to Sentry as error events, with the workflow, run id and failing node, using a project DSN.

fields.name: dsn
fields.label: DSN
fields.help: The DSN holds a public key and your organization's ingest host. Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

egress.note: The ingest host is in your DSN. If it is not under ingest.sentry.io, or Sentry is self-hosted, approve the host in the DSN instead.

notes: Events: failed runs. Sentry takes no metrics from Ogun (ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances go to the other exporters), and approvals waiting for a person are not errors.
